expected_facts.question: What are major acquisitions that Best Buy has done in FY2023, FY2022 and FY2021?
expected_facts.answer: Best Buy closed two acquisitions, both these companies were already partially owned by Best Buy, but Best Buy acquired all outstanding shares of these two companies during FY 2022: (1) Current Health Ltd and (2) Two Peaks, LLC d/b/a Yardbird Furniture
